item.description: ### Fixed - **Two Claude accounts no longer overwrite each other's usage.** If you run a second Claude Code account from another config folder (added under Settings → General → Claude config folders), Perch now shows a usage strip for each account, labelled by its folder, with that account's own limits and today's spend. Sessions from the second account get a small label too. With one account, nothing changes. - Claude Team plans are now labelled "Team".
